create_mjcf_model: create a RootElement to build a MuJoCo MJCF model programmatically with named components
attach_mjcf_model: attach another MJCF model to a site or worldbody element to compose complex robots
find_mjcf_element: find a deeply nested MJCF element by namespace and identifier without manual tree traversal
generate_mjcf_xml: generate an XML string from an MJCF element tree with configurable precision and formatting
compare_mjcf_elements: check whether two MJCF elements are semantically equivalent including attributes and children
